About Fundamental and reference

The Fundamental And Reference module provides the access to private and public company information via "TR." data items, includes:

  • Fundamentals
  • Price
  • Estimates
  • Indexes
  • Corporate Actions
  • Fixed Income
  • Lipper
  • Ownership, and so on.

"TR." data items and their parameters can easily be discovered in LSEG Workspace using the Data Item Browser (DIB).
